mapper.select: select p.*, c.category_name, u.username as seller_name from product p left join category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id order by p.publish_time desc

select p.*, c.category_name, u.username as seller_name from product p left join category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where p.product_id = #{productId}

select p.*, c.category_name, u.username as seller_name from product p left join category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where p.user_id = #{userId} order by p.publish_time desc
mapper.update: update product set category_id = #{categoryId}, product_name = #{productName}, product_desc = #{productDesc}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, quality_level = #{qualityLevel}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = #{status} where product_id = #{productId}
update product set status = #{status} where product_id = #{productId}
